$comment: Seed catalogue (PRODUCTION_PLAN task 2.13). Source: AstraPlugins/examples/web-chat/plugin.toml at version 0.1.0. A development tool with no authentication on its loopback server; the summary says so, because a store card is the last place a user reads before installing.
name: Web Chat Client
summary: A loopback browser client for Astra, for watching multi-client sync happen.
description: Serves a chat interface on http://127.0.0.1:9090 backed by your real Astra conversations, and forwards every chat event in every conversation to the browser over a WebSocket, so a message typed in the Astra window appears in the browser and the reverse, live. The last 10,000 events are replayed to a browser that connects mid-stream; nothing is written to disk. It exists to make event sourcing observable while working on Astra or on your own client. There is no authentication on that server: it binds loopback only, but anything running as you that can reach the port can read your conversations and send messages as you. A development tool, not a remote-access feature.
